title: Wikipedia - Kia Soul EV
notes: 2016-2017: 30.5 kWh gross / 27 usable, 360 V, CHAdeMO; 2018-2019: 31.8 / 30, 375 V, CHAdeMO; 2020+: 67.5 / 64, 356 V, CCS, liquid cooled, built on Kona Electric hardware (Canada only after 2020). Page says up to 100 kW DC for all (conflicts with Fastned 50 kW for CHAdeMO). No AC kW or preconditioning.
